_description: The Shellbane gryphon (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Shellbane_gryphon, /Strategies, Shellbane_Gryphon_Cave, Elder_Nama, Whirlwind, Tortugan_shield). Names are cache gamevals; tiles are the map's. Values under a `_calibrated` note have no Wiki figure.

locs._entrance: the multiloc parent: clicks arrive with its id (varbit 18321 shows it blocked or clear)

cave._bounds: the boss's cave under the Great Conch (the walkable floor runs x 3168-3189, y 8866-8881)
cave._respawnTicks: the infobox says 20 ticks (12 seconds since 17 Dec 2025)

combat._calibrated: the Wiki gives no weights: how often a ranged auto replaces a melee one, and how often a special replaces an auto

knockback._heavyWeight: a heavy player's knockback weight against 1 for each other special: the Wiki's 'prioritises' gives no figure

spit._every: the Wiki's captures: one value every 5 ticks
spit._calibrated: the Wiki's talk page: about +125 ranged defence brings every splat down to 3

messages._unverified: noTask, noLevel, devastating, heavyEquipment and regains are the Wiki's own wording, not a capture; the whirlwind, burst and corrosion lines are recorded (rsprox 3456), colours included
messages.noTask: You can only fight the gryphon in this cave if you've been assigned to do so by a Slayer Master.
messages.noLevel: You need a Slayer level of 51 to fight the Shellbane gryphon.
messages.devastating: <col=ff3045>The gryphon's attacks are devastating! You need some sort of protection!</col>
messages.heavyEquipment: The gryphon tries to pick you up, but fails thanks to your heavy equipment.
messages.regains: <col=ff3045>The gryphon regains its focus and strikes!</col>
messages.burst: <col=ff3045>The whirlwinds explode outwards in a large gust of wind!
messages.killCount: Your Shellbane gryphon kill count is: <col=ff0000>{kills}</col>.
